{{Transcript|npc}}

==Standard dialogue==
* '''Player:''' Who are you and what is this place?
* '''Mandrith:''' My name is Mandrith.
* '''Mandrith:''' I collect valuable resources and pawn off access to them to foolish adventurers, like yourself.
* '''Mandrith:''' You should take a look inside my arena. There's an abundance of valuable resources inside.
* '''Player:''' And I can take whatever I want?
* '''Mandrith:''' It's all yours. All I ask is you pay the upfront fee.
* '''Player:''' Will others be able to kill me inside?
* '''Mandrith:''' Yes. These walls will only hold them back for so long.
* '''Player:''' You'll stop them though, right?
* '''Mandrith:''' Haha! For the right price, I won't deny any one access to my arena. Even if their intention is to kill you.
* '''Player:''' Right...
* '''Mandrith:''' My arena holds many treasures that I've acquired at great expense, adventurer. Their bounty can come at a price.
* '''Mandrith:''' One day, adventurer, I will boast ownership of a much larger, much more dangerous arena than this. Take advantage of this offer while it lasts.
* {{tact|end}}

==Treasure Trails==
===Elite===
* '''Mandrith:''' Answer this, please.
* {{tact|receives=a challenge clue}}
* '''Mandrith:''' Well done.
* {{tbox|You've been given a [new clue/casket]!}}
* {{tact|end}}
===Master===
* '''Mandrith:''' Here, solve this.
* {{tact|receives=a [light/puzzle] box}}
* {{tbox|Mandrith hands you a [light box/puzzlebox]!}}
* {{tact|end}}
====Talking again====
* {{tcond|If the puzzle is not solved:}}
** '''Mandrith:''' That doesn't look solved to me.
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the puzzle is solved:}}
** '''Mandrith:''' Well done [player name]. Here you go.
** {{tact|receives=a [new clue/casket]}}
** {{tbox|You've been given a [new clue/casket]!}}
** {{tact|end}}
